title: Better Bites
body:
Better Bites is a light vanilla-style food expansion datapack.

The pack aims to improve the variety of foods that the player can choose from, adding new alternatives and modifying some foods from the base game.

![Better Bites Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a7cb1d29e0dbdc8d4a6ae9b9dacfa642ee7ba65.png)

**Features:**
- _Fried Egg:_ Now you can cook any kind of chicken egg.
  
- _Golden Beetroot:_ Grants the player 90 seconds of strenght and resistance when consumed.

- _Wine:_ Grants the player 120 seconds of nausea when consumed.

- _Glowing Wine:_ Grants the player 90 seconds of nausea and 60 seconds of night vision when consumed.

- _Fancy Water Bottle:_ It works just like a normal water bottle but can be stacked (up to 16).

- _Milk Bottle:_ It works just like a milk bucket but it can be stacked (up to 16).

- _Pick-up Cakes:_ Breaking a cake will drop it as an item, independent of how many slices have been consumed. Additionally, you can combine two half-eaten cakes to make one with more slices.

- _Stackable Stews:_ All non-suspicious stews made by player are now stackable (up to 16). If you get a stew in another way, you can combine two on the crafting table to make them stackable.
